description: Fork of exp141 (E=64, out_proj nap=6, 317M, final 1.7250). Only change: learnable_attn_scale_init 0.25 -> 0.4. Motivated by exp141's converged per-layer values: L0=0.43, L1=0.47, L2=0.40, L3=0.34, L4=0.28, L5=0.28 (all > theoretical 1/sqrt(32)=0.177). Higher init should reduce the warmup distance for L0-L3 and let them lock in earlier; L4-L5 will tune downward. Same 317M params, same dims, same 8K steps.
